reviewItem.question: Does "The following embedded cache metrics are removed" mean a change to protocol-behavior:loki|name=embedded-cache-metrics (removed)?

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the embedded cache metrics `querier_cache_added_total`, `querier_cache_gets_total` and `querier_cache_misses_total`; requests made to the configured cache (`embeddedcache`, `memcached` or `redis`) are instead instrumented by `loki_cache_fetched_keys`, `loki_cache_hits` and `loki_cache_request_duration_seconds`.
